rationale: Both Sunil and Tushar are full-stack developers with overlapping TypeScript and JavaScript expertise, but bring complementary strengths to the table—Sunil's depth in AI and blockchain expands beyond Tushar's current focus on web applications, while Tushar's React and real-time systems experience could complement Sunil's full-stack AI work. They're early-career builders in adjacent cities (Bengaluru and Pune) who could explore collaborative projects spanning web, AI, or blockchain.
intro_message: Sunil Kumar Chavhan, meet Tushar Khadde — you both code full-stack across TypeScript and JavaScript, but Sunil brings AI and blockchain expertise while Tushar's building real-time web systems, so you could learn a lot from each other's stacks.
